Cameron Park Sunday MTB Ride

Waco, TX · Cameron Park · Mountain bike

No-dropBeginner friendly

Cameron Park Sunday MTB Ride is a mountain bike group ride in Waco, TX. It rolls every Sunday at 2:00 pm from Redwood Shelter, Cameron Park. About 9–11 miles, all levels. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 2:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: all levels. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @wacobicycleclub the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Cameron Park Sunday MTB Ride group ride

A no-drop trail ride on Cameron Park's 20 miles of singletrack along the Brazos and Bosque. Nine to 11 miles, all levels, led by club volunteers. Helmets required. A Tuesday and Thursday 9 am version runs in summer.
